purpose: Track inputs and decisions that cannot be fabricated by the model pipeline.

items.required_input: Official georeferenced geology and structural GIS for the Neyriz AOI
items.owner_action: Obtain from an official or licensed source and place in data/acquired/geology/ with provenance.
items.model_effect: Required before high-resolution host and structure features can be trusted.

items.required_input: Quality-screened Sentinel-2/ASTER or other suitable imagery and DEM
items.owner_action: Download from an authorized account if the provider requires login, then provide the files or credentials through the approved connector.
items.model_effect: Enables reproducible spectral, topographic and alteration features.

items.required_input: Permitted field samples with exact coordinates and multi-element assays
items.owner_action: Arrange lawful sampling and laboratory QA/QC with a qualified geologist or mining professional.
items.model_effect: Provides measured mineralization evidence and independent labels; cannot be simulated.

items.required_input: Auditable local geophysical survey selected for the deposit model
items.owner_action: Commission or obtain a qualified survey only where a geoscientist confirms it is informative.
items.model_effect: Adds subsurface evidence; not universally required for every commodity.

items.required_input: Independent spatial test labels and documented surveyed background/unknown areas
items.owner_action: Reserve before model tuning and collect from an independent campaign or source.
items.model_effect: Required for any defensible precision, recall, PR-AUC or probability calibration.

items.required_input: Current official cadastral result for each proposed target polygon
items.owner_action: Check through the official mining cadastre or provincial authority; do not infer status from the AI map.
items.model_effect: Legal gate only; never used as a geoscience predictor.
